assessment: This rotation report mixes sound infrastructure observations with weakly specified stock timing. Mining relocation and technical Fed adjustments were verified. The explicit three-year healthcare comparison split sharply: CI slightly beat AMGN, while BMY severely lagged. AMLP versus VNQ was favorable in a disclosed sensitivity window, but that window was not specified by the author. Dollar bearishness faced sustained contrary outcomes. Technology development and corporate growth remain separate from equity returns; a network image is insufficient evidence of decentralization.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
